regime_context: Hong Kong tape is narrow and defensive: only 4 of 17 themes pass the absolute-trend gate, all in banks/energy/income/conglomerates, while every tech, gaming, EV, mining and property theme is ineligible. The leader (Banks H+HK) is crowded and mean-revert tagged, so this is not a clean trend confirmation — it is a de-risked, stay-with-what-has-not-broken setup, with no durable one-narrative signal.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the crowded Banks (H+HK) leader's momentum margin over Energy (H-shares) keeps narrowing — the rotation margin is already thin at 0.168 and Banks is mean-revert tagged. I am treating Energy as the challenger, not a handoff: I would retire this watch only if Energy's score drops below High-Dividend Blue Chips and/or Banks' score prints a new local high while breadth stays above 0.7.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only top-3 theme with a trend tag (hurst_tag=trend), durability_bar 0.68 above the leader, and it is neither crowded nor over-extended. The trend-gate leg is the only validated edge, and energy is the cleanest continuation candidate on that leg.
theses.dissent: A mean-revert market with energy as a top-2 rank can be late-cycle; oil/H-share energy can gap against geopolitics headlines as fast as with them, and macro flow shows energy mentions near the bottom of the headline stack.

falsifier.text: Energy breaks below its own 20-day trailing low while Banks holds above its 20-day trailing low.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: Rank 13, score -0.875, ineligible, trend-gate failing. Even though it is the most scorable proxy, the trend-discipline leg says stay out of broken-down tech; the macro headline stack is AI/tech-heavy, which is coincident attention, not a buy trigger.
theses.dissent: Platform megacaps are the highest-attention macro theme and policy tailwinds can re-rate them violently from low bases; avoiding them risks missing the fastest mean-reversion.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK rises 10% from current level while the Hang Seng is flat or down over the same window.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: Same trend-gate failure as platform megacaps but even weaker: rank 14, score -0.933, durability_bar 0.27, breadth 0.368. Nothing in the validated leg supports exposure, and the AI/tech macro narrative is coincident flow, not a reason to override the gate.
theses.dissent: A broad China tech re-rating would lift the whole complex at once, and current negative crowding could amplify an upside reversal.

falsifier.text: China Tech & Internet theme closes back above its 50-day moving average while the Hang Seng does not make a new 20-day low.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
